purpose: Building selection and compact card above current HUD; no runtime implementation

prompts.A:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: high-fidelity fantasy game UI approval mockup, one complete 16:9 game frame.
Input image 1 is the edit target and exact composition/style reference: an actual 1600×900 frame of our game with the approved Lunar Porcelain HUD. Input image 2 is ONLY a reference for the small wooden Rapid watchtower with orange-red tiled roof and its paving; do NOT copy its obsolete HUD, debug grid, cyan capsule, or camera.
Primary request: add a compact selected-building card ABOVE the existing bottom HUD and ABOVE its row of I/B/P/O/M icon buttons, with a clear gap. The existing minimap, full-width bottom hero HUD, resource strip, clock, five navigation icons and their letter badges must stay in their exact original positions, proportions and look. Keep hero identity, field, lighting and camera. Add just one small illustrative Rapid tower matching image 2 in the world near the hero, on a small grey-paved patch, with a subtle turquoise selection mark around its base. Do not add other buildings, menus or screens. This is a concept overlay, not a new environment design.
Style: precisely match input 1's ivory pearl porcelain, plum enamel, fine warm-silver edging, turquoise jewel accents and restrained fantasy filigree. Clean Cyrillic sans-serif, readable dark-plum text. Ornament must not invade text/button padding. No dark generic tech panels, no extra currency, no red-gold redesign.
Actual current tower figures for display: damage 1, range 4.25, interval 0.45 seconds, health 10/10. Tower level I is proposed concept content, not evidence of implemented leveling.
Card text (verbatim Russian): "Rapid", "Уровень I", "Урон 1", "Дальность 4,25", "Интервал 0,45 с", "Здоровье 10/10". Three labeled actions: "Улучшить", "Переместить", "Продать". Tiny secondary captions "Цена —" and "Возврат 50%" near the corresponding actions. Use the dash for unchosen upgrade cost, never invent prices. Small close × at card upper right.
Add one discreet top-center editorial label "КОНЦЕПТ" and a small variant label in the open world, outside the HUD. These labels clarify this is an approval sketch. No new hotkeys, no fullscreen building window, no dimming veil, no full-width second HUD, no duplicate navigation. Preserve lower HUD completely. Output a single clear game-frame mockup, not a collage, no device frame.
Variant A — horizontal compact card. At the reference 1600×900 scale, card bounds approximately x300..860, y475..650: about 560×175, immediately above the left part of navigation while keeping minimap untouched. Thumbnail/name at left, two-column compact stats at right, three actions in one lower row. Keep significant world visible around the compact rectangle. Exact editorial variant caption: "А · Горизонтальная карточка".

Actions "Улучшить", "Переместить", "Продать". Captions "Цена —", "Возврат 50%".
